summary: Block 14: isolated candidate for the duplicated norm_integral_sq, both public names preserved. Candidate: replace Kernels.lean:45-62 (18 lines, byte-identical to Fourier.lean:96-113) by a 5-line wrapper whose statement is reused verbatim and whose body is EuclideanFiveColor.ProbabilityL2.norm_integral_sq applied, plus one import. Measured file length 774 -> 762 = -12, not the -16 of the pure-deletion variant (which would break the public name) and not my earlier erroneous -17: 18 - 5 - 1 = 12. No call site changes, so three consumers are untouched. Import weight measured: Fourier imports Mathlib only (closure empty, so no cycle possible); the umbrella Mathlib is already imported by five modules in closure(Kernels), so Mathlib transit is unchanged and the OAI closure count stays 15; the real cost is that Fourier acquires 17 dependents. Recommendation: DEFER - a genuine fidelity win (one duplicated proof removed) but 0.04 percent of the tree and it couples a leaf into the measure-theory half mid-audit; do it when Kernels.lean is next opened, not as a sprint item. Includes patch, candidate copy, META with both SHA256s, import DAG, affected closure manifest and SmokeNames.lean with an rfl identity check. Nothing built; shared originals and R4 unchanged.
